description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, specifying methods for stream consumption control and status retrieval.

classes.name: ISlowConsumingGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that can consume streams, allowing it to start and stop consuming and report consumption status.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Initiates the grain's role as a consumer of a specific stream identified by stream ID and namespace, using a specified provider.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Ceases the grain's stream consumption activities.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of items consumed by the grain.
